seo.description: We fit Laufen sanitaryware across Stoke Poges' large plots and substantial houses — SaphirKeramik basins and pans installed fit-only, from £3,500.

h1: Laufen bathroom installation in Stoke Poges

hero.intro: Stoke Poges is a village built around large plots and substantial houses, with Stoke Park's golf and country club lending the area its identity, and a good number of the properties we survey here have room for more than one bathroom project at a time — a second en-suite off a principal bedroom alongside a main family bathroom refit is a layout we see often. That scale works in Laufen's favour in a specific way: SaphirKeramik, the material behind Laufen's slim-rimmed basins and pans, needs careful handling and storage between delivery and fitting, and a larger Stoke Poges property generally gives us more space to keep fragile pieces safely out of the way of other trades across a multi-room job. We install Laufen sanitaryware fit-only in Stoke Poges, working from pieces you've already sourced, from £3,500.

sections.heading: What Laufen is known for
sections.body: Laufen is a Swiss manufacturer whose SaphirKeramik ceramic composite produces basins and WC pans with notably finer rims and sharper geometry than standard vitreous china allows. In a Stoke Poges property that might mean a slim-edged countertop basin in a principal en-suite, a wall-hung pan in a family bathroom, or a cloakroom basin tucked into a smaller downstairs room — the same sculptural, slimmer silhouette running through different parts of the house. We fit these pieces to whatever's been specified through a showroom or designer, as part of full bathroom, en-suite or cloakroom installations.

sections.heading: Handling SaphirKeramik across a multi-room project
sections.body: Where a Stoke Poges project involves more than one bathroom — a main family bathroom and a second en-suite, say — we plan the delivery and fitting sequence for each Laufen piece individually rather than treating the job as one undifferentiated delivery. SaphirKeramik is strong once it's fixed, but the thinner rim profile that gives it its sharp geometry is less forgiving of a knock in transit or on site than a heavier, conventional basin, so pieces destined for a later room in the sequence get stored safely rather than left exposed while earlier rooms are still being worked on.

sections.heading: Why Stoke Poges's plot sizes help
sections.body: The large plots and substantial gardens common around Stoke Park give us more flexibility than a smaller property would — relocating a waste run, widening a doorway for level access, or adding a second en-suite off a principal bedroom rarely runs into the structural constraints a terraced house would present. That same flexibility extends to how we store and sequence delicate Laufen pieces during the job: more usable space on site generally means less risk of a fragile basin or pan being knocked while other work carries on around it.

sections.heading: Fit-only, from £3,500
sections.body: We work fit-only across Stoke Poges: you source your Laufen sanitaryware and brassware, and we handle the strip-out, first fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging for however many bathrooms the project covers. Every job starts with a fixed-price £125 survey. If you're specifying Laufen for a bathroom or en-suite in Stoke Poges, get in touch to arrange a survey.

faqs.q: Can you fit Laufen across more than one bathroom in the same Stoke Poges property?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly work on projects covering a main family bathroom and a second en-suite in the same house, and we plan the delivery and handling sequence for each Laufen piece separately.

faqs.q: Why does Laufen need more careful handling than other sanitaryware?
faqs.a: Laufen's SaphirKeramik material gives its basins and pans thinner rims and sharper geometry than standard vitreous china, which makes them less forgiving of a knock in transit or on site, so we give storage and sequencing more attention.

faqs.q: Does Stoke Poges's larger housing stock change the installation?
faqs.a: It generally gives us more room to plan layout changes and store fragile pieces safely, but the fixing and plumbing itself is confirmed at survey on every property regardless of size.

faqs.q: What does a Laufen installation in Stoke Poges cost?
faqs.a: Fit-only installation starts from £3,500, with a fixed-price £125 survey at the start of every project.
